what: When the hand rests on a header menu item for .12 seconds, the white panel below opens from height 0 to its content height in .35s power3.out (the backdrop fades in over .3s) and the items inside float up from 8px below after .1s over .3s (spread across .25s in total). When you move to a neighboring item while it is open, the panel grows or shrinks to the new content height in .4s, the old item is pushed 30px opposite to the direction of travel and disappears in .2s, and the new item slides in 30px from the direction of travel. When you leave the panel and .15s passes, the items go off by moving 4px up over .14s and the panel folds in .25s power2.in.

options.morph: Panel height duration (seconds) when switching to the next item, default .4
options.enter: Wait time after hover before opening (ms), default 120 — opens immediately if already open
options.leave: Wait before leaving and closing (ms), default 150
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Opening item — paired with the panel via data-key
options.[data-fx-part=box]: Panel whose height changes (holds the overlapping panels)
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: One content slide inside the panel — paired with an item by data-key
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Items rising one after another within the board

use:
Item
Item
note: The box is set to overflow:hidden and height 0, and the content inside (panel) is stacked (position:absolute). On touch screens it opens and closes by press only instead of hover. Esc or pressing the scrim closes it
